subject: Alcove - request for temporary log retention addendum and evidence
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@alcove.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary log retention addendum and evidence

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our security team — Alcove is preparing for an external audit and needs a short-term retention carveout for tenant debug logs for one of our pilot namespaces. Our standard requirements for the audit team are 180 days of tenant-scoped debug logs (index + session traces). We understand Redwood's default ephemeral retention is 30 days for those artifacts.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) provide a temporary addendum to extend debug-log retention to 180 days for the "alcove-pilot" tenant, 2) supply SOC 2 scope evidence or equivalent artifacts (redacted), and 3) share a SIG/CAIQ mapping that shows the controls around log access, deletion, and proof-of-delete?

We are happy to sign a limited addendum for the pilot and accept compensating controls if needed. Procurement is on standby for a quick DocuSign.

Thanks — Elena Park
Security Lead, Alcove Health

---
Attachments: none listed in message

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@alcove.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention addendum and evidence

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can support a temporary carveout for a named tenant, but there are two paths: Hosted retention extension (short-term policy change + proof-of-delete workflow) or a Dedicated/private deployment where customers can control retention windows. Hosted offers faster turnaround but requires an internal exception and compensating controls (access restrictions, narrower retention scope, and audit logs).

I'll loop in Legal and Security for the addendum language. Marissa, can you confirm commercial implications and whether Alcove is okay with a limited fee for the 180-day retention? Monica, can you prepare the retention proofwork template and list the artifacts we can provide (SOC 2 redacted report, CAIQ/SIG mapping, proof-of-delete runbook).

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention addendum and evidence

Thanks — Ben. Alcove is an existing pilot account (PO: ALC-PR-3321). Procurement already indicated they can sign quickly; they typically accept addenda for short-term retention. Financially, we should treat this as a billable addendum — recommend a pro-rated monthly fee tied to storage + support.

Rishi — can Legal confirm whether the addendum template below is OK from a risk perspective (temporary retention, tenant-limited, RBAC on access, DB-level proof-of-delete, and audit exports to Alcove on request). I'll also offer a one-time evidence package: redacted SOC 2 report, our CAIQ matrix filtered to relevant controls, and a short technical runbook describing the retention enforcement and proof-of-delete steps.

Proposed next steps:
- Security to confirm artifacts that are safe to share (redacted SOC2 + CAIQ slice).
- Legal to draft short addendum (target: 1 business day).
- Monica to assemble the proof-of-delete export (template) and sample log hashes as assurance.
- I will send commercial terms and DocuSign link once Legal signs off.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Retention_Addendum_Draft.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@alcove.health>
Date: 2026-07-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention addendum and evidence

Elena — looping Legal into the thread. High level: we are comfortable with a timeboxed, tenant-scoped retention addendum provided we: 1) limit retention to a named tenant/namespace, 2) restrict access to a small engineer/security list, 3) require a documented change window and termination date, and 4) include an indemnity carveout for any data that is later requested to be deleted via SARs while the hold is active.

Please note we cannot change retention for production-shared tenants without approval from infra ops — Monica, we'll need a rollback runbook and to schedule the change during low traffic hours. Security will provide the CAIQ/SIG mapping and a redacted SOC 2 cover sheet (we will not share raw evidence that includes customer PII).

Rishi
Chief Risk Officer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: none

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@alcove.health>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log retention addendum and evidence

Hi all — operational update and deliverables attached.

Summary of what we can deliver immediately:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_Redacted.pdf (cover sheet + control mappings, PII removed) — attached.
- Alcove_SIG_CAIQ_Responses.xlsx — a filtered SIG/CAIQ mapping showing controls around logging, retention, and deletion; we have flagged the controls we consider in-scope for the addendum.
- Retention_Addendum_Draft.docx — legal language for a 180-day tenant-scoped retention for tenant "alcove-pilot", effective 2026-07-21 through 2026-12-17 (180 days), after which retention will revert to 30 days unless extended by mutual agreement.
- Proof-of-delete runbook: we will provide a sample export (hashes and timestamps) demonstrating the deletion API and a retention-change rollback checklist.

Operational notes / caveats:
- The change requires a config flag flip in the host cluster and will trigger additional storage charges; Marissa will send a pro-rated invoice.
- Access to extended logs is limited to a named access list (we've proposed 4 seats) and will be logged and auditable.
- SARs received during the hold will be coordinated: if Alcove requests deletion of a subject record that appears in retained debug logs, we will perform an appended redaction workflow and record the action.

Action items for Alcove (please confirm):
1) Sign the DocuSign addendum: https://app.docusign.com/alcove-temp-retain-addendum
2) Confirm the four engineers to grant access to (names + emails).
3) Confirm acceptance of pro-rated fee and return PO if required.

If you confirm today we can schedule the change 2026-07-22 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic).

Thanks — Monica
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_Redacted.pdf; Alcove_SIG_CAIQ_Responses.xlsx; Retention_Addendum_Draft.docx
